newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SIMEONE LOSES APPEAL OVER THREE-MATCH BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SIMEONE LOSES APPEAL OVER THREE-MATCH BAN.

text.p: Atletico Madrid midfielder Diego Simeone will miss Saturday's derby against Real Madrid after losing his appeal to have a three-game suspension overturned.
The Spanish Committee for Sporting Discipline on Friday decided to uphold the ban, imposed for stamping on Athletic Bilbao's Julen Guerrero.
Czech international Radek Bejbl is expected to take Simeone's place.
